title: Positioning machine
statement: For a symbol alphabet $\Gamma$, a number $m\in\mathbb N$ of work tapes, source and destination indices $\mathrm{src},\mathrm{dst}\in\mathrm{Fin}(m)$, and symbols $\mathrm{zero},\mathrm{one}\in\Gamma$, define an $m$-work-tape Turing machine by composing a copy pass from the source tape to the destination, a scan of the destination using the constant map with value $\mathrm{zero}$ and the unit state, and a machine that writes the one-symbol word $[\mathrm{one}]$ on the destination tape.
